header: CH07 | FRIDAY | 4:05 PM | The Pumpkin Girl

lines.speaker: VO
lines.text: Friday. Day five. Dad kept his promise. And this time, he brought backup.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Where do I hide? There's nowhere to hide!

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: Quick! Be a decoration!

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: A what?

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: Stand still. Don't breathe. Think pumpkin thoughts.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Right, ghost. It's you, me, and the vacuum.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Lily? What are you doing up here?

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: Tea party. With the decorations.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: You put the Halloween stuff out already? It's not even Halloween.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: I like to plan ahead.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: That's my girl. Let's see. Skeleton. Witch. Giant pumpkin girl.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Hmm. I don't remember buying a pumpkin girl.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Very realistic. Kinda dusty. Smells like cinnamon.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Lily, why do the decorations smell like cinnamon?

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: They're festive.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Well, she's filthy. Hold still, pumpkin girl. Time for a good vacuum.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Dad! I'll clean the attic. Your football's starting!

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Already? You're a good kid, Max.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Nice decoration. Very realistic.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Lily. Dinner. Five minutes.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: I almost got hoovered.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: He fixed your pumpkin.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: He didn't notice. Boys never notice anything.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: Sure.

actions.text: Hard cut: the attic in the afternoon. Skye and Lily mid tea party. The ladder creaks below; the hatch starts to lift.
Lily jams a plastic pumpkin bucket on Skye's head. Skye freezes in a scarecrow pose between a skeleton and a witch.
Dad climbs in, dragging a vacuum cleaner.
Dad leans in, nose to nose with Skye. She doesn't blink.
He raises the vacuum nozzle toward her face.
Dad climbs down. Max climbs up, looks at the pumpkin girl for a long moment, and straightens the pumpkin on her head.
